title: Authority of Parliament
subArticles: (3) For the purposes of discharging its functions the National Assembly may - (a) ask any question to any Minister concerning public affairs in the United Republic which are within his responsibility; (b) debate the performance of each Ministry during the annual budget session of the National Assembly; (c) deliberate upon and authorize any long or short term plan which is intended to be implemented in the United Republic and enact a law to regulate the implementation of that plan; (d) enact law where implementation requires legislation; (e) deliberate upon and ratify all treaties and agreements to which the United Republic is a party and the provisions of which require ratification.

source.notes: Restored sub-article (3)(a)–(e) from PDF 'constitution.pdf'. Previous version was cut off at 'the National Assembly may -'.
